prompts.logo: Use case: logo-brand. Input: reference image is the approved visual direction banner, used solely to reproduce its brand lockup. Produce a standalone final SHAKERS logo, exactly the clean purple and teal angular interlocking S monogram and white uppercase SHAKERS lettering seen in reference. Remove ALL architectural background, effects, textures, small marks and tagline. Place ONLY that monogram and SHAKERS wordmark on a perfectly uniform solid dark navy #0F172A background. Wide horizontal canvas 3:1, logo centered with comfortable margins. Clean flat brand master, perfectly smooth solid shapes and smooth intact letters, no grain no scratches no distress, no smoke, no lighting, no gradients. Exact text: "SHAKERS". This is the clean website brand master on dark background, not a banner or brand board.
prompts.banner_general:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide finished homepage brand banner, landscape 3:1.
Input images: image 1 is the new SHAKERS identity reference (preserve S symbol and wordmark shape but render cleanly); image 2 is the old architectural group identity, inspiration only.
Primary request: design an outstanding contemporary youth ministry banner for SHAKERS. Premium experimental Swiss editorial design meets youthful music-culture graphics. Deep charcoal #0F172A background; gigantic very legible white SHAKERS wordmark occupying central-left with purple/teal interlocking S emblem beside it. On the right a striking abstract sculptural mirrored architectural portal made of purple ribbons and cyan contours, recalling the old symmetric architecture and expressing forward movement. Small lime graphic registration ticks, subtle halftone and restrained grain on BACKGROUND ONLY. Flat clean typography.
Text verbatim: "SHAKERS" and smaller "HECHOS PARA ALGO MÁS."
Composition: strong intentional hierarchy, generous safe margins, spacious 3:1 horizontal banner, no mockup, no frames, no buttons, no UI. Main lettering entirely inside canvas, readable at phone width. All background flourishes subordinate to branding. No people, no invented event dates, no extra slogans or text. Clean intact logo and words, no distressed lettering.
prompts.banner_colaboradores:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: finished wide 3:1 website banner for Shakers collaborators.
Input images: image 1 the finished new main banner is the mandatory identity and quality reference; image 2 the old collaborators image is inspiration for the circular motif only.
Primary request: create the companion collaborators banner to image 1. Use exactly the same clean white geometric SHAKERS wordmark and interlocking purple/teal S symbol as image 1, large on the left. Below wordmark place exact text "COLABORADORES" in beautifully spaced clean sans-serif capitals, significantly readable. On the right transform the old multicolor rings into a sophisticated sculptural composition of two intertwining elliptical ribbons, predominantly purple and teal with a small lime edge accent, implying team unity. Deep charcoal navy background, restrained halftone corners and tiny lime registration marks coordinate with image 1. Airy strong editorial hierarchy. Keep text intact and all inside safe margins.
Text verbatim: "SHAKERS" and "COLABORADORES". No other text.
Constraints: one polished flat banner image, no mockup, no people, no watermarks, no rainbow overload, no distressed lettering, not a collage of designs. Clear family resemblance to the main banner but distinct circular team graphic.
